proposal.reason: Primary change is a full CI test-orchestration redesign: replacing the old PR test workflow with source-sanity, introducing CSV-driven case execution, artifact/NAS cache staging, and strict result reconciliation for single-node and two-node runs. It also makes an independently substantive review-policy change by wiring PR secret-scan/commit/AI/human approval gates to control whether self-hosted and internal result-processing jobs can execute.
